---
title: "Topic: Innovation"
---

*Use at baseline and endline. Drawn from the Community Innovation Survey (CIS), the standard EU instrument for measuring firm-level innovation.*

---

### Product Innovation

**During the last three years, did your company introduce any new or significantly improved goods or services?**
- Yes
- No

**If yes: How many?**


**Were any of these new or improved goods or services:**
*(Select all that apply)*
- New to your firm, but already available in your market
- New to your market (your firm was first to introduce them)
- New to the world


**What share of your company's total turnover in the last financial year came from goods or services that were new or significantly improved in the last three years?**
- None
- Less than 5%
- 5–19%
- 20–49%
- 50% or more


### Process Innovation

**9.4 During the last three years, did your company introduce any new or significantly improved processes?**
*(Select all that apply)*
- Production or service delivery methods
- Logistics, delivery, or distribution methods
- Supporting activities (e.g. accounting, IT, purchasing, maintenance)
- None

**If yes: How many?**


**9.5 Who developed these process innovations?**
- Mainly your company
- Your company together with other enterprises or organisations
- Mainly other enterprises or organisations

*Source: CIS. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

### 9C. Organisational and Marketing Innovation

**9.6 During the last three years, did your company introduce any new organisational methods in business practices, workplace organisation, or external relations?**
- Yes
- No

*Source: CIS. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

**9.7 During the last three years, did your company introduce any new marketing methods (e.g. changes in product design, packaging, promotion, pricing, or sales channels)?**
- Yes
- No

*Source: CIS. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

### 9D. Innovation Expenditure

**9.8 During the last financial year, did your company have expenditure on the following innovation-related activities?**
*(Select all that apply and provide approximate amounts in €)*
- In-house R&D
- External R&D (contracted out)
- Acquisition of machinery, equipment, or software for innovation
- Acquisition of external knowledge (e.g. patents, licences)
- Training for innovation activities
- Market introduction of innovations (e.g. market research, advertising)
- Design and other creative work

*Source: CIS. Use at: Baseline and endline.*
